unit.title: 2D Shapes
unit.blurb: Naming and describing polygons by their sides and angles, regular and irregular shapes, tessellation, and lines of symmetry.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Identify, describe and sort 2D shapes, including regular and irregular polygons, and recognise shapes that tessellate.

O2.t: Identify lines of symmetry in 2D shapes and patterns, and complete symmetrical shapes.

p: A **polygon** is a flat shape with straight sides. A pentagon has 5 sides, a hexagon 6, a heptagon 7, an octagon 8.
A **regular** polygon has all sides and all angles equal. Shapes **tessellate** when they fit together with no gaps or overlaps, like squares on a floor.
A shape with 6 sides of different lengths is still a hexagon – an irregular one.

p: A **line of symmetry** divides a shape into two halves that are mirror images.
A regular polygon has as many lines of symmetry as it has sides: a regular hexagon has 6.
A rectangle's diagonals are not lines of symmetry.
